latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Editor

- Instantly convert uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) into shareable video clips using natural language instructions.
- Automatic cloud rendering with transitions, background music, and 1080p MP4 export by default.
- No editing software required—just upload photos and describe your desired video.
- Fast processing: get results in 30–60 seconds for typical 30-second slideshows.
- Seamless session management, balance checks, and multi-language prompts supported.
- Designed for social media creators and marketers seeking quick, professional video outputs from images.
